notablePrerequisites:
Crab Umbra attached to Kiki-Jiki.
Opponents control at least four artifacts and/or enchantments.
description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Dockside Extortionist with haste.
When the token enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least four Treasures.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{U}.
Activate Crab Umbra by paying {2}{U}, untapping Kiki-Jiki.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite Treasures, you may instead create token copies of any other nonlegendary creature you control.
